name: Astral Ruff Open-Source Python Linter and Formatter
free_limit: MIT-licensed local Python linting and formatting CLI with hundreds of built-in rules, auto-fixes and editor integrations; unlimited local use without a subscription.
watch_out: You provide your own workstation or CI runner; remote CI, repository hosting and third-party integrations may cost money. Ruff does not include a hosted code-quality dashboard or paid infrastructure.
